title: Vanguard Optimized
description: A Minecraft ModPack Thinked For Everyone
body:
🛡️ VANGUARD OPTIMIZED

The next step beyond Fabulously Optimized — faster, smoother, and built for everyone.

⚙️ FEATURES

- ✔️ Better performance than Fabulously Optimized
- ✔️ Fully optimized for both low-end and high-end PCs
- ✔️ FPS boost with Sodium, Lithium & FerriteCore
- ✔️ Shader support with pre-tuned Iris settings
- ✔️ Lightning-fast world and menu loading
- ✔️ Clean visuals without losing the vanilla feeling
- ✔️ Reduced RAM and CPU usage
- ✔️ Zero lag spikes and smoother chunk rendering
- ✔️ Perfect stability for long play sessions
- ✔️ Enhanced texture and shader compatibility
- ✔️ Lightweight and easy to install
- ✔️ Optimized configurations for every setup
- ✔️ Constantly updated and improved
- ✔️ Built for maximum performance — by Vanguard
